text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 14 · 沙丘边的星象观测廊.
Environment:  A tranquil desert observatory gallery built from ivory sandstone and warm bronze, huge precisely cut rectangular aperture opens to silvery sand dunes and a pale dawn sky. A delicate non-humanoid brass armillary sphere on a low plinth at left, narrow oak writing surface with rolled blank charts; long shallow steps down to an open center viewing platform. White stone ceilings with thin geometric skylight slots, architectural mass and soft luminous air, elegant distant-future archaeology grounded in real materials. No lasers, screens, robots, statues or visible stars required in daylight, quiet awe.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 14 · 沙丘边的星象观测廊. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
